# OpenCodeAttachment

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.OpenCode` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/interaction/physics-hold/Editor/OpenCode/OpenCodeAttachment.cs#L13)

One file queued to go out with the next message.
The server reads attachments off disk itself rather than taking their bytes, so an
attachment is really just a validated path plus the media type to declare for it. Getting
either wrong fails silently - a malformed url makes the whole message vanish server-side
without an error reaching the client - so both are built here and nowhere else.

### Url {#url}

The url the server resolves. Built through [`Uri`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.uri) so the result is a proper
three-slash file url with an absolute path: a two-slash "file://Assets/x" reads the
first segment as a hostname and the server goes looking for a network share.
